forces.title: Global wellness economy expansion drives broader consumer health spending
forces.description: The global wellness economy is projected to grow by approximately 8% annually through 2030, outperforming many discretionary categories. This robust expansion is fueled by consumers increasingly viewing fitness and health through a holistic lens, moving beyond traditional exercise to encompass overall well-being. This creates significant tailwinds for the Consumer Health & OTC sector, especially for categories like nutraceuticals, functional foods, and self-care products, as consumers allocate more spending to health-related adjacencies.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: GLP-1 consumer market rapidly expanding across diverse health indications
forces.description: The GLP-1 consumer market is undergoing rapid expansion, with the US user base tripling since 2022 and projected to double by 2030. This growth is driven by broadening indications beyond type 2 diabetes to include obesity, sleep apnea, cardiovascular risk, and MASH. Enhanced access through digital platforms, employer coverage, telehealth, and anticipated Medicare expansion further solidifies its consumer health product status, fundamentally reshaping related health management and wellness sectors.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: GLP-1s drive significant shifts in consumer food and supplement purchases
forces.description: GLP-1 adoption is fundamentally altering consumer spending patterns, leading to increased demand for functional foods and dietary supplements. Users are significantly increasing purchases of protein, fiber, collagen, peptides, and amino acid supplements, as well as meal replacement shakes and functional gut health beverages. Conversely, spending on sugary drinks, candy, salty snacks, and baked goods is declining. This permanent shift presents a strong structural tailwind for wellness, FMCH, and nutraceuticals, requiring product portfolio adjustments.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

forces.title: AI-driven discovery transforms consumer purchasing journeys for wellness products
forces.description: AI is increasingly influential in consumer product discovery, with over 50% of US consumers using AI across wellness "occasions," especially during pivotal life stages like weight-loss journeys or new fitness goals. Consumers are shifting from product-specific searches to holistic questions, where AI can provide integrated recommendations for products, advice, and training plans. This creates a significant upside opportunity for Consumer Health & OTC brands to compete for visibility within AI-generated recommendations, enhancing acquisition and market reach.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: UK government investment boosts access to national obesity care programs
forces.description: The UK government has partnered with Eli Lilly for an £85 million Obesity Pathway Innovation Programme, implementing 12 projects across the UK to improve access to obesity care. This direct investment signifies a strategic push to address public health needs related to obesity. For the Consumer Health & OTC sector, particularly the GLP-1 consumer market and associated wellness services, this government backing acts as a significant upside driver, fostering innovation and expanding the reach of consumer-facing obesity management solutions.
forces.source_title: Life Sciences Sector Plan: One Year On

forces.title: Broadening consumer wellness definition drives demand for holistic solutions
forces.description: Consumers are expanding their definition of wellness beyond physical exercise to include overall well-being, such as cardiovascular health, healthy aging, stress management, and mental health. This holistic perspective, particularly strong among older consumers and younger generations (Gen Z/Millennials), increases demand for a wider range of wellness products and services. This serves as a significant tailwind for IN060702 (Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals) and IN060703 (Women's Health & Longevity), encouraging innovation in comprehensive health solutions.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: GLP-1 adoption creates demand for aesthetic and lifestyle transformation products
forces.description: GLP-1 users exhibit distinct 'purchase archetypes,' including 19% focused on 'Aesthetic transformation' and 41% on 'Lifestyle optimization.' These groups are highly likely to purchase medical aesthetics, wellness goods and services, and actively build physical fitness and wellness routines. This creates a direct upside for IN060703 (Women's Health & Longevity, which includes therapeutic dermatology and longevity clinics) and IN060702 (Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals), as brands can cater to new self-improvement and beauty transformation needs.
forces.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

viewpoints.title: Global wellness economy projected to outpace many discretionary spending categories
viewpoints.description: The global wellness economy is expected to grow approximately 8% annually through 2030, significantly outpacing many other discretionary spending categories. This expansion creates powerful tailwinds for related consumer health sectors. Consumers are increasingly expanding their spending across a wider range of wellness categories, viewing fitness through a lens of overall well-being. This broad trend presents a strong foundation for growth and new opportunities for businesses within the Consumer Health & OTC industry.
viewpoints.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

viewpoints.title: Activewear brands urged to adapt to evolving holistic wellness consumer needs
viewpoints.description: Activewear brands, while strong in core categories, must strategically engage with consumers at key life stages and adapt offerings to shifting wellness routines to capitalize on the broader wellness economy. Future spending will increasingly flow towards adjacent categories like nutrition and weight loss solutions. Success depends on recognizing pivotal life moments, building credibility in wellness adjacencies through products, partnerships, content, and experiences, and adapting to AI-driven discovery channels.
viewpoints.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

viewpoints.title: GLP-1 consumer market poised for significant expansion and diverse user engagement
viewpoints.description: The GLP-1 consumer market in the US has tripled its user base since 2022 and is projected to double again by 2030, driven by expanding indications beyond type 2 diabetes to include obesity, sleep apnea, and cardiovascular risk. Increased access through direct fulfillment platforms, employer coverage, and broader telehealth collaboration are key factors. This robust growth signifies a major transformation in consumer health, opening avenues for related wellness and lifestyle products.
viewpoints.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

viewpoints.title: GLP-1 users are reshaping consumer spending towards functional health products
viewpoints.description: GLP-1 users are demonstrating significant shifts in purchasing behavior, with increased spending on functional foods like meal replacement shakes, gut health beverages, high protein foods, and a wide array of supplements (protein, fiber, collagen, peptides, amino acids). Concurrently, there are notable declines in categories like candy, sugary drinks, and salty snacks. This indicates a strong consumer preference for health-oriented and functional products, providing a clear directional signal for the wellness and nutraceuticals market.
viewpoints.source_title: The Unexpected Ways GLP-1s Are Transforming Consumer Behavior

viewpoints.title: UK government invests £85 million in national obesity care innovation program
viewpoints.description: The UK government, in partnership with Eli Lilly, has committed £85 million to the Obesity Pathway Innovation Programme. This initiative includes 12 projects across the UK aimed at improving access to obesity care. This significant investment underscores a strategic focus on public health challenges within the UK, directly benefiting the consumer health market for weight management solutions and related support services, fostering innovation and improved patient outcomes.

demand_drivers.description: GLP-1 therapies are approved for and broadening into multiple conditions, including type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular risk, obesity, sleep apnea, and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), increasing the eligible patient population.

Expansion of reimbursement, deepening commercial coverage via employer plans, fewer restrictions, and emergence of cash payment options are making GLP-1s more accessible. Telehealth and pharmacy benefit manager collaborations also expand reach.

pnl_drivers.description: Increased consumer acceptance and physician adoption, combined with lower out-of-pocket costs and better side-effect management, drive higher uptake rates among eligible populations.

new_opportunities.description: Four archetypes of GLP-1 users (lifestyle optimization, aesthetic transformation, disease management, all-in) create demand for adjacent wellness goods and services, including fitness, nutrition, recovery, coaching, and medical aesthetics.

market_sizing.methodology: Forecast for US GLP-1 user base growth. The active user base in the US tripled between 2022 and 2024 (from ~8.9M to ~23M). It is projected to double again by 2030 from its 2024 base, reaching 32 million active users. This growth is driven by expanding indications, increased uptake due to physician adoption and consumer acceptance, and improved access via various platforms and coverage expansions.
